title: We’ll free you
from pain and tension
text: Massage Heaven is a massage studio in the heart of Warsaw, at Krucza 16/22. Before we begin, we talk for a moment — about what’s bothering you, what you expect and how firm the pressure should be. Only then do we choose the technique.
We combine therapeutic techniques with relaxing rituals, so that every visit is time just for you — unhurried, quiet and warm.
